defs.def: having the ability or qualities necessary for doing sth 有能力；有才能

ex.s: Volunteering makes you feel capable and inspires you to make the most of each day.
ex.t: 志愿服务让你感到自己有能力，并激励你充分利用每一天。

ex.s: When hiring committees see this, they see candidate who is capable of working in a variety of environments.
ex.t: 当雇用委员会看到这一点时，他们就会看到能够在各种环境中工作的候选人。

ex.s: It is capable of using GPS technology to travel to different places, with computing technology controlling its “legs”.
ex.t: 它能够利用GPS技术前往不同地点，由计算技术控制它的“腿”。

ex.s: Of course, it could be very useful to have a more advanced form of AI — a truly independent form of artificial intelligence, capable of exercising its own judgement, could help us solve many of the world’s problems.
ex.t: 例如，如果你想说"别紧张"，你可能会用"保持冷静，carry on"这个短语。

ex.s: Humans are capable of making decisions by themselves without input from others, and they can learn from experience.
ex.t: 人类能够不依赖他人而自己作决定，并可以从经验中学习。

ex.s: Today, the creation of an allpowerful computer capable of human thought is still in progress.
ex.t: 今天，创造一台具备人类思维、无所不能的计算机仍在进行中。

ex.t: 对初学者来说，这是一项很棒的运动——你不需要健身房会员或任何特别的设备。也没有比这更好的方式来认识自己，看看自己有多大的潜力。

defs.def: having the ability to do things well 能力强的；足以胜任的

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。
